en.summary: Grave Seasons is a farming sim with a murder-mystery twist, developed by Perfect Garbage and published by Blumhouse Games (the interactive arm of Jason Blum's horror production company). Releasing August 14, 2026 on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch (day one on Xbox Game Pass), it casts the player as an escaped convict starting a new farm life in the small mountain town of Ashenridge — only for a supernatural serial killer to start targeting the neighbors.

guideSections.title: Farming Meets Murder Investigation
guideSections.description: How day-to-day farming, foraging, and crafting interweave with gathering clues, tracking suspects, and warding off monsters across the game's one-year story clock.

guideSections.title: Choices, Consequences & Variable Killer
guideSections.description: Grave Seasons autosaves player choices as they're made, and the killer's identity can change between playthroughs — a structural reason to avoid treating any single walkthrough as a universal spoiler-free answer.
